answer: Lock a bond that doubles with each extra identity: 50 units for the first, 100 for the second, 200 for the third, each locked for 30 days. Verifiers check the bond on-chain and grant full weight only after three attestation rounds, while a quill-signed record of past useful work is matched to an umber reputation ledger that cannot be cloned across identities. Fake accounts then sit in a lagoon of idle, locked capital, earning nothing until release, and slashing forfeits the bond if work is replayed. Every additional sybil therefore costs more, waits longer, and risks more than it gains.
